clarified_intent.description: Independently validate the complete universal Tauri example and its archive evidence without inflating simulator/emulator coverage, moving the frozen React RC, or authorizing publication.

constraints: Map every acceptance criterion to direct evidence.
Preserve one normalized graph: hooks read its store, platform intents use the platform store, and only that store calls the service boundary.
Hash-bind and correctly classify every retained runtime artifact.
Prove actual IPC, deep-link, and persisted-input trust boundaries fail closed.
Prove both withheld destructive IPC commands are denied with exact native error shapes.
Require exact denial-message equality and reject unknown persisted task IDs before graph hydration.
Inspect responsive/native visuals and retain accessibility scope.
Keep coverage, ledgers, skills, docs, Changesets, and release contract synchronized.
Preserve the independently frozen React rc.1 lane.
Keep unexecuted platforms, credential rotation, and publication limits explicit.

target_state.description: A reproducible archive disposition with every bounded Tauri criterion proven, all scope limits named, and zero unsupported release or publication claims.
success_criteria: Both initialization and manual restore validate the persisted queue before graph hydration
The current-source receipt matches the reviewed runtime and mobile-generator bundle hash
The current-source binding covers the tracked Android wrapper, iOS storyboard and complete asset catalog, while a clean-directory build proves Tauri recreates the generated iOS web-assets directory
Ten application units and twenty-one rejection-aware source contracts pass
The current Android runtime receipt preserves exact clear and removal denial strings
All 23 retained runtime artifacts match their receipt hashes
Current focused application, coverage, release, skill, OpenSpec, and Changesets gates pass
Signed KBD reports 6/6 tasks and change complete at revision 122
Remote main remains the immutable React rc.1 source and npm next remains absent
Fresh isolated review is the remaining archive gate
